scope: Extend allocation rollback/retry coverage for the transactional DRW_Surface encoder to Extruded, Revolved, Swept, Lofted and NURBS subtype bodies and deferred lofted handles.

coverageChanges: Generate valid profiles for all five remaining typed subtypes with subtype-specific data and exact class ordinals.
Include swept source/path payload bytes and a lofted profile with cross-section, guide-curve and path handles.
implementation.failureBehavior: Injected allocation failure preserves caller stream bytes and bit positions and restores the writer object type; same-object retry into the same buffers reproduces clean output.

validation.allocationSweep: PASS: 5,174 allocation offsets across nine entity families and 305 entity/version/stream-layout profiles

coverage: Plane, Extruded, Revolved, Swept, Lofted and NURBS surfaces are exercised across AC1021, AC1024, AC1027 and AC1032 with five stream-alias layouts each.
AC1027+ NURBS fields are checked through the writer's generated allocation/retry path; pre-AC1027 writer behavior remains covered as an admitted body profile.
Lofted cross-section, guide-curve and path handle output is included in the failure sweep.
limitations: Version-bound raw DWG body replay is not directly fault-injected by these subtype profiles.
This is transaction evidence only; it does not qualify surface wire semantics, ACIS geometry, graph closure, native rendering, source producers or output support.
No DWG or DXF drawing fixture was added.
